cases.id: case:always treasure: every catch has a chest, never golden without fishing mastery

known_issues: The golden-chest target is statistical: it requires at least one golden chest in 120 minigames. At the game's rate for a player with the mastery (25% plus average daily luck, so at least about 15%), a correct implementation fails it with probability below 1e-8.
The fishing cases open the minigame menu directly (as the game does when a fish bites) and close it after three ticks, before its fade-in completes; the catch itself is never played out.
The town animal and town pet stand in for another mod's NPC animals; they are added to Town's collections directly.
